title: Stage 6: Boss: Closing time
summary: Delete members safely in a transaction, renew loans in bulk, and report the most popular books.

steps.title: The last three features
body: Three requests from the head librarian, each a different tool from the course:

1. **Delete a member** who leaves. Their loan history blocks the delete (`Restrict`), on purpose: you must decide. Refuse while books are still out; otherwise remove their past loans and the member **together**, in one transaction.
2. **Renew** every active loan of a member by some days, with a single set-based `UPDATE` (`ExecuteUpdateAsync`), not by loading each loan.
3. A **popular books** report, computed by the database in one query.
Everything from the earlier stages is tested again.

steps.prompt: Deleting a member runs `ExecuteDeleteAsync` on their loans, then `Remove(member)` and `SaveChangesAsync`. Why wrap both in a transaction?
options: `ExecuteDeleteAsync` runs at once, outside `SaveChanges`; without a transaction a failure in the second step would leave the loans deleted and the member still there
Because the member relationship uses Restrict
steps.explain: Bulk methods are immediate commands, each its own little transaction. To make two of them (or one plus a `SaveChanges`) all-or-nothing, open one transaction around both.

items: Renew all of a member's active loans by 7 days
Delete a leaving member's past loans
Lend a book (check copies, bump the version)
Edit a book's title with a version check
steps.explain: Per-entity rules and concurrency tokens need the change tracker. Set-based changes with no per-row logic are one SQL statement.

steps.title: Closing time
prompt: Keep everything from stage 5 and add:

- `DELETE /members/{id}`: `404` if missing; `409` if the member has any loan not yet returned; otherwise, in **one transaction** (`BeginTransactionAsync`), delete their loans with `ExecuteDeleteAsync`, remove the member, save, commit: `204`.

- `POST /members/{id}/renew` with `record Renewal(int Days)`: `400` unless 1 to 30 days; `404` for an unknown member; otherwise move the `Due` of each of their **active** loans forward by that many days with **one** `ExecuteUpdateAsync` (`l.Due.AddDays(input.Days)` translates to SQL). `200` with `{ renewed: n }`.
- `GET /reports/popular?top=3`: `[{ title, author, loans }]`, books by number of loans (all time, most first), then title; `top` defaults to 3 (1..20). One query.

static class DojoTests
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("the final boss", async () =>
await Post(http, "/authors", new { name = "Frank Herbert" });
await Post(http, "/authors", new { name = "Ursula K. Le Guin" });
await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "Dune", isbn = "9780441013593", year = 1965, authorId = 1, copies = 5 });
await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "Earthsea", isbn = "9780547773742", year = 1968, authorId = 2, copies = 5 });
await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "The Dispossessed", isbn = "9780061054884", year = 1974, authorId = 2, copies = 5 });
await Post(http, "/members", new { name = "Ana", email = "ana@example.com" });
await Post(http, "/members", new { name = "Ben", email = "ben@example.com" });
await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 1, memberId = 1, due = "2026-12-01" });
await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 2, memberId = 1, due = "2026-12-05" });
await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 3, memberId = 2, due = "2026-12-05" });
await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 2, memberId = 2, due = "2026-12-20" });
await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 3, memberId = 1, due = "2026-11-01" });
await http.PostAsync("/loans/5/return", null);
await Post(http, "/members", new { name = "Cy", email = "cy@example.com" });
DojoWeb.Status("deleting Ana, who has books out: 409", 409, await http.DeleteAsync("/members/1"));
DojoWeb.Status("deleting member 9: 404", 404, await http.DeleteAsync("/members/9"));
await http.PostAsync("/loans/1/return", null);
await http.PostAsync("/loans/2/return", null);
DojoWeb.Status("with everything returned, deleting Ana: 204", 204, await http.DeleteAsync("/members/1"));
DojoWeb.Status("Ana is gone", 404, await http.GetAsync("/members/1/loans"));
DojoWeb.Status("deleting Cy, who never borrowed: 204", 204, await http.DeleteAsync("/members/3"));
DojoSql.Commands = 0;
var dojoRenew = await Post(http, "/members/2/renew", new { days = 7 });
var dojoRenewCount = DojoSql.Commands;
DojoWeb.Status("POST /members/2/renew responds 200", 200, dojoRenew);
Dojo.Eq("...renewing Ben's two loans", "2", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(dojoRenew), "renewed"));
Dojo.Check("...with a bulk update (at most 2 commands)", dojoRenewCount <= 2, $"it ran {dojoRenewCount} commands");
Dojo.Eq("the due dates moved a week", "2026-12-12|2026-12-27", Each(await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/members/2/loans")), "due"));
DojoWeb.Status("renewing by 0 days: 400", 400, await Post(http, "/members/2/renew", new { days = 0 }));
DojoWeb.Status("renewing for member 9: 404", 404, await Post(http, "/members/9/renew", new { days = 3 }));
DojoSql.Commands = 0;
var dojoPopular = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/reports/popular?top=2"));
Dojo.Eq("GET /reports/popular?top=2", "Earthsea|The Dispossessed", Each(dojoPopular, "title"));
Dojo.Eq("...with loan counts", "1|1", Each(dojoPopular, "loans"));
Dojo.Check("...in one SQL command", DojoSql.Commands == 1, $"it ran {DojoSql.Commands} commands");
DojoWeb.Status("an edit with a stale version is still 409", 409, await http.PutAsJsonAsync("/books/1", new { title = "X", year = 1, version = 0 }));
Dojo.Eq("paging still works", "3", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books?pageSize=1")), "total"));
static async Task<HttpResponseMessage> Post(HttpClient http, string url, object body) => await http.PostAsJsonAsync(url, body);
static async Task<string?> Id(HttpResponseMessage r) => DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(r), "id");
static string Each(JsonElement json, string prop) =>
json.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array ? string.Join("|", json.EnumerateArray().Select(x => DojoWeb.Prop(x, prop))) : "(not an array)";
static JsonElement Field(JsonElement json, string name)
if (json.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) return default;
foreach (var p in json.EnumerateObject()) if (string.Equals(p.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return p.Value;
return default;
static class DojoSql
public static int Commands;
[System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ModuleInitializer]
internal static void Start() => System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticListener.AllListeners.Subscribe(new Watcher());
sealed class Watcher : IObserver<System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticListener>, IObserver<KeyValuePair<string, object?>>
public void OnNext(System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticListener listener) { if (listener.Name == "Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore") listener.Subscribe(this); }
public void OnNext(KeyValuePair<string, object?> e) { if (e.Key == "Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command.CommandExecuted") Interlocked.Increment(ref Commands); }
public void OnError(Exception error) { }
public void OnCompleted() { }
